author: GitHub
description:
Microsoft Comic Chat is officially open source on GitHub. Originally shipped in 1996 with Internet Explorer 3, this classic IRC client turned plain text conversations into visual comic panels. It was also one of the first programs to feature the now-famous Comic Sans font. The repository includes the original source snapshots along with modernization experiments to run it on current versions of Windows.
